verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has a dedicated pricing docs page describing a 7-day free trial and a Lite plan with 10 GB free storage and free monthly compute. It bills by the second, offers fixed Duckling instance sizes (Pulse through Giga), and shuts idle instances down at no cost, so the cost model's structure is clear. The pack shows no actual rates, so a pre-commit monthly estimate can't be fully built; the usage SQL views and billing dashboard help only after you start running workloads. Missing for 10: per-second/per-hour rates for each Duckling size, per-GB storage pricing, paid plan tiers, a cost calculator or worked billing examples, and independent confirmation that estimates match actual bills.
